title: Associate Degrees in Hand, 'Not the Right Skill Match,' Launching Prairie Twin Interactive, & The Arvin Road Networking Closet
description: Back home in Virginia Beach after their birthday week in Alexandria, Katie and Nate apply for traditional web-development jobs with their CCHR associate degrees and PHP/SQL skills—only for employers to carefully reject them with legally safe 'not the right skill match' excuses once they roll in with power wheelchairs, inspiring the twins to launch their own paid client web studio under their Virginia LLC, convert their office closet into a ventilated networking closet, and stumble by sheer random luck onto a Minnesota StreamTube turtle-habitat channel that makes them think wistfully of Cousin Chelsea.
